'''Horst Devalo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[ComOps]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served as [[Second Lieutenant/Legends|second lieutenant]] onboard the [[Lancer (freightliner)|''Lancer'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], Horst served in [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] fleet, which was sent to [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] to [[Battle of Mindor|attack]] the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]]. At the beginning of the battle, Horst informed [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tirossk]] that he received a signal from the ''Justice'', when it crashed landed on the planet.
